tool_args.rationale: The open-branch probe establishes gradient dependence, but the seven observations do not distinguish the coupled two-layer bridge from alternative saturating mechanisms across the input space. Additional trajectory observations are warranted before numerical fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a single saturating recruitment law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The added observations show a strong dependence on s_grad that the recalled Beverton–Holt law ignores.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a two-layer flux-conserving siphon now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only two observations vary s_grad, while the other inputs are fixed; the coupled mechanism and its parameters remain underidentified.
It does not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
